description: This file contains unit tests for the PerformanceReviewDao class within the OrangeHRM performance plugin, specifically testing methods like retrieving performance reviews, handling transactions, and updating reviewer comments.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing PerformanceReviewDao methods including retrieval, creation, updating, and exception handling related to performance reviews.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture, creating an instance of PerformanceReviewDao and populating test data.

methods.name: testGetPerformanceReviewList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of performance reviews with specific filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetPerformanceReviewCount
methods.description: Tests counting the number of performance reviews based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetEditableReviewById
methods.description: Verifies fetching an editable performance review by ID, checking both existing and non-existing reviews.

methods.name: testGetSupervisorRecord
methods.description: Tests retrieval of supervisor records for given employee and supervisor IDs, including non-existent cases.

methods.name: testCreateReviewWithTransactionException
methods.description: Simulates an exception during review creation to verify transaction handling and exception throwing.

methods.name: testUpdateReviewWithTransactionException
methods.description: Simulates an exception during review update to ensure proper transaction exception handling.

methods.name: testGetPerformanceSelfReviewStatus
methods.description: Checks the status of self-reviews based on reviewer status, including various reviewer states.

methods.name: testUpdateReviewerComment
methods.description: Tests updating a reviewer comment and verifies the change persisted correctly.
